disclosures.title: SABIC Earnings Release Q2 2026
disclosures.body_text: SABIC announced its financial results for the second quarter of 2026: revenue of SAR 24.81 billion, EBITDA of SAR 3.79 billion and a net loss attributable to equity holders of the Parent of SAR 0.83 billion.
